title: Create: Liquids
description: This mod adds some liquids and drinks using the create mod for the recipes!
body:
# Create: Liquds
Create: Liquids is a Create Addon that introduces a few of craftable fluids and drinks to Minecraft, each with different effects and uses.

### Features:

End Fuel — A fluid that teleports any player who touches it to the End.

Coolant — A liquid with no current purpose

3 new items

1 new advancement to unlock

**This mod is currently in _early development._ New liquids, uses, and features are planned** — Coolant will be getting functionality in a future update. 

Suggestions and feedback would be very appreciated in the Discord!

### Requirements:

Mod Loader: Forge

Minecraft: 1.20.1
